title-group.article-title: Exampletinib inhibits kinase X in a synthetic study

sec.title: Background
sec.p: Kinase X drives growth in model systems.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Exampletinib reduced kinase X activity with an IC50 of 12.5 nM in cell-free assays.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: Assays used recombinant kinase X at 37 °C.

sec.title: Potency
sec.p: The oral bioavailability of exampletinib in rats was 45% after a single dose.
Comparatortinib showed no activity against kinase X at concentrations up to 10 µM.
